Utility Programs

Command line tools for checking and repairing DataReel database files.

Contents

Tools

Tools

  • db_debug: analyze, dump and rebuild gxDatabase files.
  • ix_debug: analyze and check gxBtree index files.

Both are built by CMake into cmake-build/utils and installed with the library. The 6.x hexdump, ffind and txfilter programs were removed; use your system's tools (xxd, find, sed, PowerShell Format-Hex) instead.
